title: Soul Feast #22: Saying What is Most Difficult in Spiritual Partnership
excerpt: In this Soul Feast of The Gary Zukav Deepcast, Gary explores one of the most profound aspects of spiritual partnership—the courage to speak the things we fear will destroy the relationship.
bodyHtml:
In this Soul Feast of The Gary Zukav Deepcast, Gary explores one of the most profound aspects of spiritual partnership—the courage to speak the things we fear will destroy the relationship. 

Unlike traditional relationships, where difficult truths are often avoided to maintain harmony, spiritual partnerships thrive on honest, courageous communication. Sharing these truths with the intention to challenge fear in yourself, or to support your partner to challenge fear in themselves, deepens connection and accelerates spiritual growth.

Gary explains how the frightened parts of our personality—those rooted in fear, jealousy, and insecurity—seek to hide or suppress difficult truths. 

However, true authentic power is created when we confront these fears by speaking openly and honestly with our spiritual partners. 

He shares personal experiences that illustrate how revealing deep fears, past wounds, or even present attractions can strengthen rather than weaken relationships—as long as the intention is to move beyond the control of fear.

The key to saying what is most difficult in a spiritual partnership is ensuring the intention behind it is rooted in love rather than manipulation or self-interest.

 When both partners commit to honest self-exploration, emotional responsibility, and mutual growth, the partnership becomes a sacred space for transformation and healing.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:

  • (01:59): How spiritual partnerships require saying what we fear will destroy the relationship.
  • (04:18): Why avoiding difficult conversations creates distance and separation.
  • (06:41): The importance of intention behind revealing difficult truths.
  • (09:05): How honesty in spiritual partnership accelerates growth and deepens trust.
  • (15:37): Why spiritual partnership replaces traditional relationship models.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge: Take time to reflect on the most difficult thing you could say to your spiritual partner—something you fear could harm or even end the relationship. Write it down in your journal. Then ask yourself: What is my intention for sharing this? Is it to challenge a frightened part of my personality and move beyond fear? If so, consider having the conversation with love, courage, and emotional awareness.
